items.html: And for this reason the right strap, where the coronet of Hesed is, is hidden within the navel of the heart, as above, which is at the place of the chest; for from there and below begins the building of the female, and it is all finished and ceases there at the chest. And what enters within is only a very small matter, entering and descending to the Yesod of ZA himself, as is known, for there it stands and is gathered.
